attchmntText: Tamil Nadu Newsprint & Papers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Outcome of the Board Meeting held on 13th November, 2026'.
voiceSummary: Tamil Nadu Newsprint and Papers Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. The Board also placed before shareholders for approval via postal ballot the re-appointment of Tmt M Sathiyavathy, I.A.S., Retd., with DIN 02357307, as Independent Director for a three-year term from 27.11.2026 to 26.11.2029. Additionally, the appointment of Thiru V Arun Roy, I.A.S., with DIN 01726117, as Director is subject to shareholder approval. The cut-off date for voting is 13th November, 2026. Thiru CS R Sridharan has been appointed as the Scrutinizer for the remote e-voting process.
